name: stick-to-bottom
title: Stick to bottom
description: A scroll area for chats and logs that follows new content while you are at the end, and offers a Jump to latest button once you scroll up.
docs: Give it a height with className (h-80, or h-full inside a flex column). It follows only while the reader is at the end: scroll up and it lets go, and the button counts what arrived (pass newCount to count yourself, for example when you trim old items). Items are announced politely, and only while it follows; while the reader is away, the count of what arrived is announced as a status instead, at most every few seconds. Growth that arrives later, such as an image that loads, is followed too. A stream that updates many times a second reads best with behavior="instant". To pull the reader to the end after they send something, scroll an element at the end of your list into view. Under reduced motion every jump is instant.
